born.why: The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when starvation is imminent, uses smell-based filtering to avoid previously poisoned species, and distinguishes between known-safe fruits (carry/taste) and unknown ones (taste if safe, eat only if desperate), ensuring long-term learning without unnecessary risk.

The code prioritizes eating known-safe fruits, uses trait-correlation to avoid poisonous species even if new, and only tastes unknown fruits with no negative trait history, balancing starvation risk against poisoning risk.

This code optimizes survival by strictly avoiding known poisons, prioritizing immediate consumption for known-good fruits to mitigate starvation risk, and restricting exploration of unknown fruits to safe hunger levels to prevent fatal mistakes.

The code prioritizes survival by eating known-good fruits when very hungry, avoids confirmed poison more aggressively, and restricts tasting of unknowns to low-hunger states or specific targets to prevent starvation during learning.

This code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when starving, uses tasting to efficiently resolve uncertainty about new fruit species without risking a full meal, and switches to carrying for known-safe fruits to build pantry reserves and reduce future foraging effort.
